steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward, and tuck your tailbone under.
Gently shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back-leg hip.
Hold while breathing slowly, then switch sides.
Hip Flexor Stretch.mistake: Arching the lower back instead of tucking the pelvis, which moves the stretch out of the hip.

steps: On hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Inhale and drop your belly while lifting your chest and tailbone, as in the cow.
Exhale and round your spine up toward the ceiling, tucking your chin, as in the cat.
Cat-Cow Stretch.mistake: Rushing through the movement instead of moving one vertebra at a time with each breath.

steps: Step into a deep lunge and place both hands inside your front foot.
Rotate your torso toward the front knee and reach that arm up to the ceiling.
Return your hand to the floor, straighten the front leg, then switch sides.
World's Greatest Stretch.mistake: Letting the back knee drop and the chest collapse, which loses the hip and spine opening.

steps: Stand facing a wall with one foot a few inches away, toes pointing forward.
Drive your knee forward over your toes toward the wall while keeping your heel on the floor.
Return, then move your foot farther back as the range improves.
Ankle Mobility Drill.mistake: Letting the heel lift off the ground, which hides the ankle tightness you are trying to fix.

steps: Sit or stand and extend one leg in front with the heel down and the toes up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch along the back of the thigh.
Hold while breathing slowly, then switch legs.
Hamstring Stretch.mistake: Rounding the back to reach the toes, which stretches the spine rather than the hamstring.

steps: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance, and bend one knee to bring your heel toward your glutes.
Hold your ankle and keep your knees close together, pushing your hip slightly forward.
Hold while breathing slowly, then switch legs.
Quad Stretch.mistake: Letting the knee drift forward or the lower back arch, which loses the stretch in the thigh.

steps: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it, one foot back with the heel on the floor.
Keep the back leg straight and lean forward until you feel the stretch in the calf.
Hold while breathing slowly, then switch legs.
Calf Stretch.mistake: Letting the back heel lift or the foot turn out, which takes the stretch off the calf.

steps: Stand tall with your arms relaxed by your sides.
Roll your shoulders up, back and down in slow, large circles.
Reverse the direction after a few reps.
Shoulder Circles.mistake: Making small, quick circles, which only wiggle the shoulders instead of using the full range.

steps: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Draw small circles with your hands, gradually making them larger.
Reverse the direction after a set number of circles.
Arm Circles.mistake: Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears while the arms circle.

steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly drop your chin to your chest, then roll your ear toward one shoulder.
Continue in a gentle half circle, then repeat on the other side.
Neck Rolls.mistake: Rolling the head backward in a full circle, which compresses the back of the neck.

steps: On hands and knees, place one hand behind your head.
Rotate that elbow down toward the opposite arm, then open it up toward the ceiling.
Follow the elbow with your eyes and repeat, then switch sides.
Thoracic Spine Rotation.mistake: Twisting from the lower back instead of keeping the hips still and rotating through the upper back.

steps: Stand on one leg, holding a wall for balance, and lift the other knee to hip height.
Draw slow, large circles with the knee, rotating at the hip.
Reverse the direction, then switch legs.
Hip Circles.mistake: Leaning the whole body to swing the leg instead of moving only from the hip.

steps: Stand next to a wall for balance and swing one leg forward and back in a controlled motion.
Keep your torso tall, gradually swinging a little higher each time.
Switch to side-to-side swings across your body, then change legs.
Leg Swings.mistake: Swinging with force and arching the back instead of building range gradually.

steps: Stand tall and step forward, pulling one knee up to your chest with both hands.
Squeeze for a second while you rise slightly onto the toes of the other foot.
Release, step forward and repeat on the other leg.
Walking Knee Hugs.mistake: Rounding the back to bring the chest to the knee instead of lifting the knee up.

steps: Stand tall and bend one knee to hold your ankle behind you, keeping your knees together.
Push your hip forward slightly and hold for a second.
Release, step forward and repeat on the other leg.
Walking Quad Stretch.mistake: Leaning forward or letting the knee flare out to the side, which loses the stretch.

steps: Stand tall, then bend forward and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Walk your hands out to a plank, keeping your legs as straight as you can.
Walk your feet toward your hands in small steps, then stand up.
Inchworm.mistake: Bending the knees a lot and rushing, which skips the hamstring stretch.

steps: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides.
Lift one leg and swing it across your body toward the opposite hand, rotating your hips.
Return, then repeat on the other side, keeping your shoulders on the floor.
Scorpion Stretch.mistake: Letting the shoulders lift off the floor as the leg crosses over.

steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Thread your hands behind the bottom thigh and pull it toward your chest.
Hold while keeping your head and shoulders relaxed, then switch sides.
Figure-Four Stretch.mistake: Letting the crossed knee fall in or lifting the head off the floor to pull harder.

steps: Sit tall with the soles of your feet together and your knees dropped out to the sides.
Hold your feet and lean forward from your hips with a flat back.
Hold while breathing slowly and let the knees relax toward the floor.
Butterfly Stretch.mistake: Pressing the knees down with your hands, which strains the inner knee.

steps: Sit with your legs straight in front of you and your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from your hips and reach toward your feet with a long spine.
Hold where you feel a stretch along the back of your legs, breathing slowly.
Seated Forward Fold.mistake: Rounding the upper back to reach farther, which shifts the stretch away from the hamstrings.

steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and one arm reaching overhead.
Bend sideways from your waist, keeping your hips still.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
Standing Side Bend.mistake: Leaning forward or twisting as you bend, which loses the stretch along the side.

steps: On hands and knees with your fingers pointing forward, shift your weight gently back and forth.
Turn your hands so the fingers point sideways, then back, shifting gently each time.
Move within a comfortable range and stop if anything pinches.
Wrist Mobility Drill.mistake: Forcing weight onto the wrists too fast instead of easing in gradually.

steps: Sit on the floor with your front leg bent 90 degrees in front and your back leg bent 90 degrees to the side.
Sit tall, then lean your chest over the front shin until you feel a stretch in the outer hip.
Hold, then rotate to switch sides.
90/90 Hip Stretch.mistake: Leaning back on your hands to get comfortable, which removes the stretch.

steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Sit down as low as you can with your heels down and chest up.
Press your elbows against your knees and hold, breathing slowly.
Deep Squat Hold.mistake: Letting the heels lift or the back round, which means you are past your current range.

steps: Start in a high plank, then step one foot outside your hand.
Sink your hips toward the floor and press your knee out with your elbow.
Return to plank and switch sides.
Spiderman Lunge.mistake: Letting the back hip sag, which loses the plank position.

steps: Stand with your feet wide and your toes turned out slightly.
Shift your weight to one side and sit down into that leg while the other leg stays straight.
Push back up through the heel, shift across to the other side and repeat.
Cossack Squat.mistake: Letting the heel of the working leg lift as you sit, which strains the knee.

steps: Stand with your feet wide, one arm reaching overhead and the other hanging.
Hinge to the side, sliding the lower hand down your leg while watching the upper hand.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch sides.
Windmill Stretch.mistake: Bending forward at the waist instead of hinging from the hip.

steps: Hold a stable support at about hip height and sit your hips back.
Drop your chest between your arms until you feel a stretch down the side of your back.
Hold, breathing into the stretch, then step out of it slowly.
Lat Stretch.mistake: Arching the lower back instead of keeping the spine long.

steps: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body as you open your chest.
Hold while breathing slowly and keeping your ribs down.
Chest Opener Stretch.mistake: Pushing the ribs forward and arching the lower back to lift the arms higher.

steps: Sit with your legs wide apart and your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a long spine until you feel the stretch along the inner thighs.
Hold while breathing slowly.
Groin Stretch.mistake: Rounding the back and dropping the chin to the chest instead of hinging at the hips.

steps: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front and the other crossed over it.
Hug the crossed knee toward your opposite shoulder with a long spine.
Hold while breathing slowly, then switch sides.
Piriformis Stretch.mistake: Twisting the spine to pull harder instead of keeping the hips square.

steps: Stand with one leg crossed behind the other and reach the same-side arm overhead.
Lean away from the back leg, pushing that hip out to the side.
Hold while breathing slowly, then switch sides.
IT Band Stretch.mistake: Leaning forward instead of straight to the side, which skips the outer hip and thigh.

steps: Place the foam roller under the muscle you want to release, supporting your weight with your hands.
Roll slowly over the muscle, pausing for a few seconds on tender spots.
Keep breathing and avoid rolling directly over joints or bones.
Foam Rolling.mistake: Rolling quickly back and forth instead of working slowly and pausing on tight spots.

steps: Hold a light band in front of you with both hands, wider than your shoulders.
Raise your arms overhead and then back behind you as far as is comfortable, keeping your arms straight.
Reverse to the start and move the hands closer together as the range improves.
Resistance Band Shoulder Mobility.mistake: Arching the lower back to get the band behind you instead of widening the grip.

steps: Lie on your back and loop a strap around the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg toward the ceiling, keeping it as straight as is comfortable.
Hold with a gentle pull on the strap while breathing slowly, then switch legs.
Yoga Strap Hamstring Stretch.mistake: Letting the lower back lift off the floor or the other knee bend.

steps: Lie with the foam roller across your upper back and your hands behind your head.
Lower your upper back back over the roller, gently opening the chest.
Move the roller up or down a few inches and repeat.
Foam Roller Thoracic Extension.mistake: Letting the ribs flare and the lower back arch instead of keeping the core lightly braced.

steps: Stand or sit with a massage ball under your foot.
Roll slowly from the heel to the ball of the foot, pausing on tender spots.
Apply moderate pressure and breathe, then switch feet.
Massage Ball Foot Rolling.mistake: Pressing so hard that you tense up, which defeats the release.

steps: Loop a band around a sturdy anchor and the top of your thigh, then step away to tension it.
Get into a lunge or kneeling position facing away from the anchor.
Let the band pull your hip back and sit into the stretch, breathing slowly.
Band-Assisted Hip Opener.mistake: Letting the band pull the hip forward instead of staying tall and tucking the pelvis.

steps: Lie on your side with the foam roller under the outer thigh.
Roll slowly from just above the knee to the hip, supporting yourself with your arms.
Pause on tender spots, breathing steadily, then switch legs.
Foam Roller IT Band Release.mistake: Rolling directly over the outside of the knee, which is a bony joint.

steps: Sit on the floor with a lacrosse ball under one glute.
Cross that ankle over the opposite knee and lean into the ball.
Roll slowly over tender spots, breathing steadily, then switch sides.
Lacrosse Ball Glute Release.mistake: Rolling the ball onto the lower back or the tailbone instead of the glute muscle.

steps: Set the machine for the stretch you want and adjust the pad to fit your body.
Move slowly into the stretch until you feel a gentle pull, not pain.
Hold while breathing slowly and release before you switch.
Assisted Stretch Machine.mistake: Forcing the range with the machine's help beyond what the muscle is ready for.

steps: Wade into waist-deep water and walk forward with an upright posture.
Add side steps, high knees and leg swings, moving with slow, wide motions.
Let the water support you and keep the movements smooth.
Pool Walking Mobility.mistake: Hunching over or rushing the movements, which wastes the chance to move through full range.
